name: sentiment-reproducibility
research_question: How far does a pure-Python text classifier move under controlled perturbations of the corpus version, the feature space, the learning rate and the software environment - relative to how far it moves when only the random seed changes?
hypothesis: The corpus version dominates because it changes the label noise. The environment does nothing at all, because this pipeline has no threads and no floating-point reductions that could reorder.
headline: logistic-regression scored 0.6490 +/- 0.0134 on accuracy over 10 seeds, which is not distinguishable from any of the 1 baselines at this sample size.

claims.statement: logistic-regression scored 0.6490 against naive-bayes's 0.6593 on accuracy (10 replications each, -0.0102 [-0.0207, 0.0002] at 95% confidence). This difference is not distinguishable from noise (paired-t, adjusted p=0.0542). With n=10 per condition this is an absence of evidence, not evidence of absence. This design could only have detected a difference of 0.0146 or larger.

implementation (naive-bayes-as-implementation): moved accuracy by +0.0102 [-0.0002, 0.0207], 0.8x the seed noise; stability 0.69 [0.50, 0.87] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=0.090), and whether it stays within the declared tolerance of 0.01 is undecided: the interval straddles that boundary.

environment (hash-randomised): moved accuracy by +0.0000 [0.0000, 0.0000], 0.0x the seed noise; stability 1.00 [1.00, 1.00] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=1.000), within the declared tolerance of 0.01.

environment (single-threaded): moved accuracy by +0.0000 [0.0000, 0.0000], 0.0x the seed noise; stability 1.00 [1.00, 1.00] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=1.000), within the declared tolerance of 0.01.
configuration (lr-0.2): moved accuracy by -0.0215 [-0.0264, -0.0166], 1.6x the seed noise; stability 0.31 [0.19, 0.43], beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01.

configuration (more-epochs): moved accuracy by +0.0015 [-0.0036, 0.0066], 0.1x the seed noise; stability 1.00 [0.92, 1.00] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=0.716), within the declared tolerance of 0.01.
dataset (sentiment@v2): moved accuracy by -0.1010 [-0.1205, -0.0815], 7.5x the seed noise; stability 0.00, beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01.

Deterministic: 4 executions of an identical run produced identical values on every result metric (accuracy, f1, vocabulary_size). train_seconds varied, as expected: those measure the machine rather than the method.

limitations: With 10 replications and the observed spread, this design could detect a difference of 0.0146 in accuracy or larger 80% of the time at alpha=0.05. The difference actually measured (-0.0102) is smaller than that floor, so a null result here is a statement about the experiment's resolution, not about the methods.
Changing the configuration moves accuracy by -0.0215, beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01. Results should not be expected to reproduce across configuration changes.
Changing the dataset moves accuracy by -0.1010, beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01. Results should not be expected to reproduce across dataset changes.
Whether a change of implementation keeps accuracy within its declared tolerance of 0.01 is undecided: the interval [-0.0002, 0.0207] straddles that boundary. More runs on that axis would resolve it.

reproducibility.method: stability(axis) = 1 - max(0, (|Cliff's delta| - E|delta|_null) / (1 - E|delta|_null)), where E|delta|_null is the mean |Cliff's delta| under random relabelling of the same samples. The seed axis is the reference noise floor and is not scored.

seed.description: seed: 10 seeds of 'logistic-regression' give accuracy = 0.6490 +/- 0.0134 (CV 2.07%), mean [0.6394, 0.6586]. A replication using 5 of these seeds would reach the same conclusion 100% of the time. Read that with care: with 5 runs the smallest attainable p-value is 0.0625, above alpha, so the agreement reflects a shared inability to detect anything rather than a shared detection.
seed.role: reference noise floor; not scored as a perturbation

reproducibility.description: Across 6 perturbation axes, the most fragile is 'dataset' (stability 0.00); the geometric mean is 0.02. Changing configuration, dataset moves accuracy beyond the tolerance declared for it, so a reproduction differing on those axes should not be expected to match. On implementation the data cannot decide whether the shift stays within tolerance; more runs would be needed to say.
notes: Axes from most to least fragile: dataset (0.00), configuration (0.31), implementation (0.69), environment (1.00), environment (1.00), configuration (1.00)
These axes move the result further than one seed standard deviation: dataset (7.5x), configuration (1.6x). A paper reporting seed variance alone would understate its own uncertainty on them.
